flavor: A sudden, rhythmic thumping echoes through the corridor as the floorboards begin to heave. From the shadows, a pale, bloated 僵尸 emerges, its jaw unhinged and dripping with a thick, syrupy red liquid that smells intensely of fermented 樱桃. It begins to perform a grotesque, jerky dance, its movements part of a macabre 上演 that demands an audience.
name: The Maraschino Mime
reason: The party triggers a pressure plate that releases a reanimated corpse coated in sticky, acidic fruit nectar.
